source.title: https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-wall-ball
source.locator: CrossFit describes the wall-ball as a deep front squat plus push press/throw requiring midline stabilization, considerable ROM, target accuracy, catching and coordinated core-to-extremity timing.

source.title: https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/hspu-and-you-master-the-movement
source.locator: CrossFit places wall handstand as a prerequisite for HSPU and emphasizes safe inverted support, shoulder strength/control and progression.

source.title: https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/hspu-and-you-master-the-movement
source.locator: CrossFit requires established wall-handstand control plus pressing-strength prerequisites before strict HSPU, supporting high inversion/ROM demands and very high strength/technical demand.

source.title: https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/hspu-and-you-master-the-movement
source.locator: CrossFit requires established wall-handstand control plus pressing-strength prerequisites before strict HSPU, supporting high inversion/ROM demands and very high strength/technical demand.

source.title: https://library.crossfit.com/premium/pdf/CFJ_November09_Collected.pdf
source.locator: CrossFit gymnastics progression describes headstand push-ups as pressing from headstand to handstand; inversion and pressing demand substantial control, shoulder ROM and strength.

source.title: https://library.crossfit.com/premium/pdf/CFJ_November09_Collected.pdf
source.locator: CrossFit gymnastics progression uses controlled headstand/handstand pressing and lowering; the eccentric variant retains inversion, shoulder ROM, pressing control and technical positioning demands.

source.title: https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/hspu-and-you-master-the-movement
source.locator: CrossFit HSPU progression requires wall-handstand control and substantial pressing strength; parallettes preserve inversion while increasing usable pressing ROM.

source.title: https://www.nasm.org/resource-center/exercise-library/modified-push-up
source.locator: NASM presents modified push-up as an accessible beginner pressing progression with reduced load and difficulty; wall support further reduces loading and balance demand.

source.title: https://www.acefitness.org/resources/everyone/exercise-library/
source.locator: Wall-supported isometric squat-family positioning removes most balance demand while retaining knee/hip positioning and lower-body endurance/strength requirements.

source.title: https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-straddle-press
source.locator: CrossFit describes straddle press-to-handstand as developing balance, coordination and full-body control; press progressions require shoulder opening, hip elevation, compression and controlled lowering.

source.title: https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/hspu-and-you-master-the-movement
source.locator: Wall handstand is an explicit HSPU prerequisite; despite wall support, inversion requires active shoulder support, body control and overhead range.

source.title: https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-wall-walk
source.locator: CrossFit states wall walks challenge coordination and upper-body strength while maintaining handstand elements under multi-point support.

source.title: https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-ring-dip
source.locator: Dip-family pressing requires upper-body strength, stability and control through shoulder extension; external load raises execution demand while support remains constrained.

source.title: https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-single-leg-squat
source.locator: CrossFit identifies the pistol as advanced and requiring balance, coordination, considerable relative strength and great ankle/knee/hip flexibility; loading increases the challenge.

source.title: https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/workout-tips-for-210909
source.locator: CrossFit programs weighted pull-ups above strict and kipping variants in a pulling-stamina progression; added external load substantially increases pulling-strength demand.

source.title: https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-single-leg-squat
source.locator: CrossFit identifies single-leg squat as advanced with considerable balance, mobility and relative-strength requirements; external loading preserves and increases these demands.

source.title: https://www.acefitness.org/resources/pros/expert-articles/5565/4-moves-to-help-you-master-the-pull-up/
source.locator: ACE describes unassisted pull-up as challenging, requiring back/arm strength, trunk stabilization and correct scapular packing; wide grip adds shoulder-position ROM demand.

source.title: https://www.acefitness.org/resources/everyone/blog/7038/body-weight-training-don-t-let-a-lack-of-equipment-keep-you-from-your-goals/
source.locator: ACE includes wide-grip push-up as a standard scalable bodyweight exercise across beginner-to-advanced rep ranges.

source.title: https://www.acefitness.org/resources/pros/expert-articles/5565/4-moves-to-help-you-master-the-pull-up/
source.locator: ACE pull-up guidance emphasizes shoulder/scapular positioning and vertical pulling mechanics; supported pulldown reduces balance while wide grip retains shoulder-position demand.

source.title: https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-ring-row
source.locator: CrossFit states ring rows develop core and upper-body strength together with balance and coordination; ring stabilization adds active control.

source.title: https://assets.crossfit.com/pdfs/seminars/SMERefs/Gymnastics/GymnasticsCourse_SeminarGuide.pdf
source.locator: CrossFit gymnastics material places windshield wipers as an auxiliary toes-to-bar drill and scales them by tuck; straight-leg hanging rotation requires substantial core strength, control and range.
